**What's left in Unapplied Cash – $3,000.00 (Evergreen Bank, JE-00291 / BT-US-0081)**

Evergreen has *no* open invoices — their Jan, Feb and Mar subscriptions ($6,200 each) are all paid in full — and $3,000 matches nothing. It could be a prepayment, a duplicate, or payment for something unbilled, so I left it in 2950 and logged it as **EXC-001** recommending AR get remittance detail from the customer.

US 2950 now ends March at exactly the $3,000 Evergreen credit; UK and DE are nil. One side note for whoever does the US bank rec: bank lines BT-US-0077 and BT-US-0081 are still unmatched in the bank-rec module.
